name: TLS认证、隧道隔离及多客户端
summary: 复用原Go证书和账户/隧道认证，Rust仅接受经授权的generation与lane。

defaults.auth: Account/password, SNI, offline32B route-key and trusted server certificate; native device/lane IDs, no TLS-prelude.
defaults.auto-ip: client opt-in --auto-ip; server --lease-pool memory-only 7-day original lease; default outer IP MTU remains 1460
defaults.installation-id: client saves only installation ID at --installation-id-file (0600); no persisted IP address

usage.cli: Client --record-cipher chacha20-poly1305 (default), aes-128-gcm or aes-256-gcm protected original TLS policy; offline32B route-key and TLS trusted CA. Server does not override client's cipher.
usage.config: Original TLS one443 verified per-client Normal/Game/FEC/cipher, auto/manual IP; shared Rust TUN and local offline32B route-key, outer default1460.
usage.gui: WinForms route-key hex/file plus scoped trusted TLS CA; Android/physical Wi-Fi pending.
